##### Project General Facts

Knightsbridge Phase 2, by LEOS Developments, is a masterpiece of contemporary design, blending the architectural heritage of Knightsbridge, Mayfair, and Hyde Park in London with a unique climate-adaptive wellness approach. This low-density community features two exquisite villa formats, the Chatsworth five-bedroom villa and the Blenheim six-bedroom signature villa, each showcasing a two-storey layout with elevated ceiling heights and a private in-plot pool. The masterplan is carefully designed to create a self-contained wellness environment, complete with re-oxygenating water features, biodiverse landscaping, and a self-shading building envelope.

The community amenity programme at Knightsbridge Phase 2 is centered around a stunning swimmable sunrise lagoon, surrounded by an array of luxurious amenities, including an outdoor cinema, a kids' aqua park, an outdoor jacuzzi relaxation zone, and the Ripple Water Café. Residents can also enjoy a lakeside jogging track, aqua sunbeds along the water, and a BBQ and smoke house pavilion, all connected via a dedicated sikka pedestrian passage to Phase 1. Each villa boasts a climate-controlled outdoor shaded terrace, a Karesansui Zen garden, balcony gardens, and a private in-plot swimming pool, showcasing the perfect blend of relaxation and entertainment.

Interiors at Knightsbridge Phase 2 are crafted from natural, biodegradable materials, carefully selected to harmonise with the surrounding water and greenery. Each villa features a private in-villa elevator, an in-house cinema room, and generously proportioned hallways, all complemented by integrated smart-home systems, in-unit beverage chillers, and premium interior appointments. The Blenheim signature villa is offered in both regular and corner configurations, providing residents with a unique and tailored living experience, complete with an enhanced drainage system and a ten-year waterproofing warranty.


##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa 3 is a highly sought-after location, providing effortless access to Dubai's major attractions and landmarks. The area is characterised by its serene atmosphere, with lush greenery and a relaxed ambiance, perfect for those seeking a tranquil retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. Wadi Al Safa 3 is strategically positioned to offer a unique blend of seclusion and connectivity, with major highways and transportation links nearby, ensuring that residents can easily explore all that Dubai has to offer.

The surroundings of Wadi Al Safa 3 are defined by their natural beauty, with rolling hills and verdant landscapes creating a picturesque backdrop for a luxurious lifestyle. The area is also conveniently located near several premium leisure and lifestyle experiences, including golf courses, parks, and shopping destinations. Wadi Al Safa 3 is an ideal location for those who value privacy and exclusivity, while still being connected to the vibrant pulse of Dubai's city life.

Wadi Al Safa 3 boasts an unparalleled quality of life, with its unique blend of natural beauty, luxurious amenities, and convenient access to Dubai's major attractions. The area is perfect for families, individuals, and couples alike, offering a tranquil and relaxing atmosphere, coupled with endless opportunities for entertainment and exploration. Wadi Al Safa 3 is a true gem in the heart of Dubai, providing a unique and unforgettable living experience.
